svg.title: AppleJuice execution path
svg.desc: A Windows game passes through AppleJuice’s own macOS-native PE/DLL loader, which operates independently of Wine and Windows, then to resident ARM64 translation. AppleJuice implements its own native Windows API compatibility layer, which also runs without Wine or Windows. Direct3D maps to Metal with optional MetalFX upscaling. The macOS audio branch supports HRTF headphone mixing alongside native input and file services.

g.text: Fully native macOS PE / DLL loader
AppleJuice’s native Windows API compatibility layer
Implemented by AppleJuice · Runs without Wine or Windows
